transfer_provisions.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Executive order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act which are applicable to the committees listed in Section 1 of this order, except that of reporting annually to Congress, shall be performed by the head of the department or agency designated after each committee
transfer_provisions.note: Neither EO 11868 nor EO 11860 is listed in sec. 1, so the sec. 2 transfer of FACA functions does not reach them.

exceptions.quote: Executive Order No. 11868, as amended, establishing the President's Commission on Olympic Sports, is revoked effective January 16, 1977.
exceptions.note: A target-specific effective date: EO 11868 is revoked on 1977-01-16, later than the general sec. 5 date.

exceptions.quote: This order shall be effective December 31, 1976.
exceptions.note: General effective date. The sec. 4(a) revocations (EO 11667, 11809, 11860) and the sec. 4(b) supersession of EO 11827 take effect 1976-12-31; sec. 3 sets its own later date for EO 11868.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 3 revokes EO 11868 'as amended' 'effective January 16, 1977'. Sec. 4(a) revokes EO 11667, 11809 and 11860 without a date and sec. 5 makes the order effective December 31, 1976, so those revocations took effect 1976-12-31 (signed 1976-12-20; printed 41 FR 55705-55706, December 22, 1976). Secs. 1-5 read in full.

targets_in_batch_06.EO:11868: sec. 3 ('Executive Order No. 11868, as amended ... is revoked effective January 16, 1977'); whole order, no qualifier
targets_in_batch_06.EO:11860: sec. 4(a)(3) ('Executive Order No. 11860 of May 19, 1975 ... [is] revoked'); whole order, effective 1976-12-31 under sec. 5. The machine ACT scope 'partial' for EO 11860 comes from the sec. 1 chain label and is wrong: sec. 4(a) lists the order without any qualifier. EO 11860 is BLOCKED in this batch for a different reason (its own 'conclude its work within one year' wording).

conclusion: EO 11948 (signed 1976-12-20, 41 FR 55705, PDF pages 13-14, read once in full) continues thirteen advisory committees to 1978-12-31 (sec. 1), reassigns FACA functions for those committees (sec. 2), revokes EO 11868 as amended effective 1977-01-16 (sec. 3), revokes EO 11667, 11809 and 11860 and supersedes EO 11827 (sec. 4) and is effective 1976-12-31 (sec. 5). It has no savings, pending-matter or transition clause. The sec. 2 transfer does not reach EO 11868 or EO 11860.
